title: Map-centred app template
purpose: Apps where the map is the primary workspace: places with a category, shown as markers with clustering, selection and a detail panel; search, filters, viewport and current-location behaviour; a keyboard-accessible list of the same records; owner-scoped add / edit / hide / delete; an admin table for records and categories. Maps through app.maps (geocoding, reverse geocoding, OpenStreetMap tiles), photos through app.storage. Not for two-sided markets (use template-marketplace with its map mode) or back-office records (template-workspace).

security_compliance.notes: Written from the Application Standard, not extracted from an existing app (the archetype investigation found no safe map-first source). Every statement is owner-scoped or visibility-scoped on :__user_id; management tools are gated by app roles admin / editor and declared caller_unscoped. No map provider key: tiles, geocoding and routing come from app.maps' OpenStreetMap backing. Fixes the base template's three known deviations (PAS-AUTH-001, PAS-UI-002, PAS-UI-007).
